steps.title: Getting the computer ready to open Wikipedia
steps.rationale: I'll start by opening Wikipedia and visiting each article to collect the information. Let me begin.

steps.title: Searching for Alan Turing on Wikipedia
steps.code:
await page.type({ ref: "e24", text: "Alan Turing", submit: true })
await wait({ waitTime: 2 })
var snap = await page.snapshot()
console.log(snap.snapshot.outline())
steps.rationale: The Wikipedia homepage is loaded. Now I'll search for each person. Let me start with Alan Turing.
